financials_interim.notes: Colombo Fort Investments PLC (CFI, Company No PQ 100) is NOT a conventional trading/operating company -- it is itself an unlisted-fund-style closed-end investment/holding vehicle that holds a portfolio of quoted equity investments (part at Fair Value through OCI, part at Fair Value through P&L) and discloses Net Asset Value per share (Rs.541.25 as at 30.06.2026). Structurally it closely resembles CINV/CIT (same family of Sri Lankan cross-holding investment companies -- CFI's own 20-largest-shareholder note on this filing shows 'Colombo Investment Trust PLC' (CIT) holding 35.32% of CFI, and conversely CIT's own filing this quarter shows CFI holding 28.82% of CIT -- a reciprocal cross-holding; S. Shanmugalingam and Anushman Rajaratnam sign as directors on both companies' filings). Unlike CINV/CIT, however, CFI's own SOFP is a genuine conventional-style balance sheet (Receivables, Prepayments, Cash, Trade & Other Payables all separately disclosed, no current/non-current ambiguity), so it fits this project's standard schema directly rather than needing the fund-specific NAV-only treatment. This is a SINGLE set of statements, single entity (no subsidiaries), so basis=GROUP by convention. Fiscal year end is 31 March, so the quarter ended 30 June 2026 is Q1 of FY2026/27. revenue = the filing's own 'Revenue' line (29,560, Q1 FY26/27 vs 51,170 Q1 FY25/26, -42% YoY) -- not itemised into dividend vs interest income in this filing. cost_of_sales = 'Cost of Investments disposed' (nil this quarter vs Rs.20,431k in the prior-year quarter, when the company realised disposals). The filing's real profit driver sits in a line with NO dedicated schema field -- 'Net change in Fair Value through Profit or Loss Financial Assets' (Rs.45,421k this quarter vs Rs.233,484k prior-year quarter, -81% YoY) -- this is folded into operating_profit ('Operating Profit' 71,777, the filing's own subtotal after Revenue - Cost of disposals + FV change - Administrative Expenses (3,204)) rather than any gross_profit/cost_of_sales derivation, since the schema has no 'fair value gain' field. finance_costs = 2,113 (Finance Costs this quarter; nil prior-year quarter). profit_before_tax (69,664) - tax_expense (0, no income tax charged either quarter) = profit_after_tax (69,664), ties exactly. trade_receivables = 'Receivables' (75) -- an immaterial catch-all receivables balance, not trade receivables in the conventional sense (this company has no trading operations), but it is the closest available schema field and the amount is trivial. inventory left blank -- not applicable, the FVTPL/FVOCI investment portfolio (Rs.4,908,587k total per the fair-value hierarchy note) is not inventory. No borrowings of any kind are disclosed (short_term_borrowings/long_term_borrowings left blank; the only liability is Trade & Other Payables plus a small Dividends Payable). total_assets (4,909,565) = total_liabilities (70,966) + total_equity (4,838,599) exactly. shares_in_issue = 8,939,651 (per the Stated Capital note) -- cross-checked against EPS: 69,664k / 8,939,651 = Rs.7.793, ties to disclosed EPS Rs.7.79. Cash flow: cash_from_operations = 'Net Cash Flows from (used in) Operating Activities' (-268). capex left blank -- there is no PPE; the only investing outflow is 'Acquisition of Financial Assets at FVOCI' (918), which is portfolio investment activity, not capital expenditure, so it is recorded only in cash_from_investing (-918) and not double-counted as capex. cash_from_financing = 0 this quarter (dividend paid was nil this quarter vs Rs.12,817k in the prior-year quarter). KEY DRIVER: the 73% YoY fall in Operating Profit (Rs.71,777k vs Rs.261,447k) was driven almost entirely by a much smaller unrealised fair-value gain on the FVTPL portfolio this quarter (Rs.45,421k vs Rs.233,484k a year earlier, -81%) plus the absence of any gain on disposals (nil vs a Rs.20,431k realised cost-of-disposal charge booked in the prior-year quarter) -- the underlying 'Revenue' (dividend/interest) line was also down 42% (Rs.29,560k vs Rs.51,170k).

interim_updates.note_text: Colombo Fort Investments PLC (CFI), a closed-end investment/holding vehicle (not an operating company), reported a sharp YoY decline for Q1 FY2026/27 (quarter ended 30 June 2026): Profit for the period fell 73.4% to Rs.69.66mn from Rs.261.45mn a year earlier, and Revenue (dividend/interest income) fell 42.2% to Rs.29.56mn from Rs.51.17mn. The entire swing is attributable to a single, clearly identified line with no dedicated schema field: 'Net change in Fair Value through Profit or Loss Financial Assets', which fell 80.5% to a Rs.45.42mn unrealised gain this quarter from a Rs.233.48mn unrealised gain in Q1 FY2025/26 (a Rs.188.06mn absolute decline) -- this is folded into the 'Operating Profit' line (Rs.71.78mn vs Rs.261.45mn, -72.6%) per this project's convention since the schema has no fair-value-gain field. A second, smaller contributor: the prior-year quarter carried a Rs.20.43mn 'Cost of Investments disposed' charge (from realising portfolio disposals) that is nil this quarter -- i.e. no disposals were realised in Q1 FY2026/27, removing both that cost and any associated realised gain from this period's P&L. Finance Costs of Rs.2.11mn were incurred this quarter (nil in the prior-year quarter), a minor drag. No income tax is charged in either period (CFI pays no income tax on this activity), so tax_expense is flat at nil YoY and Profit Before Tax equals Profit for the period in both quarters. Because CFI's 'Revenue' line (dividend/interest income only) is small relative to the FVTPL fair-value swings that dominate its P&L, both operating margin (242.8% this quarter vs 510.9% PY) and net margin (same, since tax=0) are structurally distorted metrics for this company and should not be read as conventional profitability ratios -- they mechanically track the size of the unrealised FVTPL gain relative to the small recurring income base, not operating efficiency.
interim_updates.gaps_note: No QoQ comparison possible: this is CFI's first financial_statements/interim_updates entry in this DB (no closer prior quarter has been collected). Genuine filing-level gaps: (1) 'Net change in Fair Value through Profit or Loss Financial Assets' (Rs.45.42mn this quarter, Rs.233.48mn PY), the single dominant driver of both the Operating Profit and Profit for the period lines, has no dedicated schema field and is folded into operating_profit -- flagged so the operating_profit figure is not mistaken for a conventional trading/operating margin; (2) the filing does not itemise 'Revenue' (Rs.29.56mn) into dividend income vs interest income, so the composition of the 42.2% YoY revenue decline cannot be further attributed; (3) no qualitative commentary (MD&A/directors' review) is included in this filing explaining WHY unrealised fair-value gains on the FVTPL portfolio were smaller this quarter (i.e. no named stock-level driver for the Rs.188.06mn swing) -- this is inherent to CFI's passive-holding-company reporting style and is a genuine disclosure gap, not an extraction miss.
interim_updates.takeaway: CFI's 73.4% YoY profit decline is a mark-to-market timing effect, not an operating deterioration: the company holds a portfolio of quoted equities and the swing is driven almost entirely by a Rs.188.06mn smaller unrealised fair-value gain on the FVTPL book (Rs.45.42mn this quarter vs Rs.233.48mn a year earlier) plus the absence of any realised disposal activity. Because CFI's small 'Revenue' line (dividend/interest income, down 42.2% to Rs.29.56mn) is dwarfed by these FVTPL swings, operating and net margins computed against Revenue (242.8% and 510.9% in the two periods) are not meaningful profitability ratios for this holding-company structure and should be read alongside NAV per share (Rs.541.25, up from Rs.466.61 YoY) for a fuller picture of value creation.

operational_highlights: Profit for the period Rs.69.66mn, -73.4% YoY (Q1 FY2025/26: Rs.261.45mn); Revenue Rs.29.56mn, -42.2% YoY (Q1 FY2025/26: Rs.51.17mn); EPS Rs.7.79 (Q1 FY2025/26: Rs.29.25).

Net change in Fair Value through Profit or Loss Financial Assets fell 80.5% YoY to a Rs.45.42mn gain from a Rs.233.48mn gain -- a Rs.188.06mn absolute decline that is the sole driver of the profit fall.
No Cost of Investments disposed this quarter (nil) vs Rs.20.43mn in the prior-year quarter, indicating no portfolio disposals were realised in Q1 FY2026/27.
Finance Costs of Rs.2.11mn incurred this quarter (nil PY) -- a minor new drag.
No income tax charged in either period; NAV per share rose to Rs.541.25 (from Rs.466.61 a year earlier) despite the lower quarterly profit, reflecting FVOCI reserve movements outside the P&L.
key_drivers: Net change in Fair Value through Profit or Loss Financial Assets fell 80.5% YoY (Rs.45.42mn vs Rs.233.48mn), a Rs.188.06mn absolute decline that alone accounts for the fall in both Operating Profit and Profit for the period -- a one-off, mark-to-market swing rather than an operating deterioration.
Absence of realised portfolio disposals this quarter (Cost of Investments disposed: nil vs Rs.20.43mn PY) removed a source of realised P&L activity present in the comparative quarter.
Underlying recurring income (the 'Revenue' line, dividend/interest) also fell 42.2% YoY to Rs.29.56mn, a secondary but genuine driver alongside the larger FVTPL swing.
